name: 79. Responses namespace tools flattened to unique names for non-namespace wires and mapped back (#7048 / PR #7082)
description: Regression coverage for PR #7082 (fixes #7048). The OpenAI Responses `namespace` tool container groups function tools; only OpenAI's own wire accepts it. Bifrost used to flatten it (in the compat plugin, behind should_convert_params) by splicing each namespace's members into the top-level list unprefixed, so two namespaces that both define `js` produced two top-level tools named `js` and the upstream rejected the request with 400 "Tool names must be unique". With the flag off, core silently dropped or mangled the container instead. Core now flattens at dispatch for every wire that lacks namespace support: members become `<namespace>__<function>`, a forced tool_choice on a bare nested name is re-aliased when it is unique, and returned function_call items are mapped back to the OpenAI shape (bare `name` plus a separate `namespace`), unary and streaming. The deepseek row is the issue's provider and the raw_request assertion pins the outbound names; the anthropic rows pin the tool_choice re-alias and the response-side restore; the openai row pins that a namespace-capable wire is left alone.

item.name: deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash /v1/responses two namespaces sharing js flatten to unique prefixed tools (raw_request) - #7048

exec:
if ([401, 403, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].indexOf(pm.response.code) !== -1) { return; }
// 400 is deliberately NOT skipped: "Tool names must be unique" is the #7048 failure signature.
pm.test('deepseek v4-flash: colliding namespaces flatten to unique names - #7048', function () {
pm.expect(text, 'pre-fix duplicate tool names reached the provider').to.not.include('Tool names must be unique');
if (typeof rr === 'string') { try { rr = JSON.parse(rr); } catch (e) { rr = null; } }
pm.test('deepseek v4-flash: outbound tools are namespace_a__js and namespace_b__js - #7048', function () {
pm.expect(rrText, 'a bare, colliding "js" tool reached the provider').to.not.match(/"name"\s*:\s*"js"/);
pm.expect(rrText, 'the namespace container must not reach a wire that does not support it').to.not.include('"type":"namespace"');

item.name: anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5 /v1/responses forced tool_choice on a namespaced function returns bare name plus namespace - #7048

exec:
if ([401, 403, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].indexOf(pm.response.code) !== -1) { return; }
// 400 is deliberately NOT skipped: "Tool names must be unique" is the #7048 failure signature.
pm.test('anthropic haiku-4-5 non-streaming: forced namespaced call comes back with bare name plus namespace - #7048', function () {
pm.expect(text, 'pre-fix duplicate tool names reached the provider').to.not.include('Tool names must be unique');
for (var i = 0; i < out.length; i++) { if (out[i].type === 'function_call') { call = out[i]; break; } }
pm.expect(call, 'expected a function_call item (tool_choice forced ping)').to.not.equal(null);
pm.expect(call.name, 'name must be the bare function name, not the flattened alias').to.equal('ping');
pm.expect(call.namespace, 'namespace must be restored from the alias map').to.equal('namespace_b');

item.name: anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5 /v1/responses streaming forced tool_choice on a namespaced function returns bare name plus namespace - #7048

exec:
if ([401, 403, 429, 500, 502, 503, 504].indexOf(pm.response.code) !== -1) { return; }
// 400 is deliberately NOT skipped: "Tool names must be unique" is the #7048 failure signature.
pm.test('anthropic haiku-4-5 streaming: forced namespaced call comes back with bare name plus namespace - #7048', function () {
pm.expect(text, 'pre-fix duplicate tool names reached the provider').to.not.include('Tool names must be unique');
pm.expect(text, 'expected the function_call to carry the bare name').to.include('"name":"ping"');
pm.expect(text, 'expected the function_call to carry its namespace').to.include('"namespace":"namespace_b"');
// extra_fields echoes the upstream wire, where the alias is expected
try { ev = JSON.parse(line.slice(6)); } catch (e) { return line; }
pm.expect(clientText, 'the flattened alias leaked to the client').to.not.include('namespace_b__ping');

item.name: openai/gpt-5-mini /v1/responses namespace tools pass through untouched on the OpenAI wire (raw_request) - #7048

exec: pm.test('openai gpt-5-mini: namespace tools accepted natively - #7048', function () {
if (typeof rr === 'string') { try { rr = JSON.parse(rr); } catch (e) { rr = null; } }
pm.test('openai gpt-5-mini: namespace container reaches the OpenAI wire untouched - #7048', function () {
pm.expect(tools, 'both namespace containers must reach the wire: ' + rrText.slice(0, 400)).to.have.length(2);
pm.expect(tools[0].tools, 'namespace_a must keep its nested js').to.have.length(1);
pm.expect(tools[1].tools, 'namespace_b must keep its nested js').to.have.length(1);
pm.expect(rrText, 'OpenAI understands namespace tools; they must not be flattened').to.include('"type":"namespace"');
pm.expect(rrText, 'no alias prefix on a namespace-capable wire').to.not.include('namespace_a__js');
